cases.purpose: On a real serial tty (/dev/ttyS0, the 8250 console UART of the guest whose driver, unlike the PTY driver, honours CSIZE and PARENB), set-ldisc, with the terminal held open so the tty reset-on-close does not discard the settings, applies CS7 with even parity and two stop bits, CS8 odd, CS7 odd, CS8 even and back to CS8 without parity, and the termios read back by Python matches each request.
cases.script:
t=/dev/ttyS0
exec 7<>$t
/usr/bin/python3 ti.py $t > st0
pty set-ldisc 0 $t 9600 7 even 2 1 256 2>e1; echo "cs7even=$?" > rc
/usr/bin/python3 ti.py $t > st1
pty set-ldisc 0 $t 115200 8 odd 1 - - 2>e2; echo "cs8odd=$?" >> rc
/usr/bin/python3 ti.py $t > st2
pty set-ldisc 0 $t - 7 odd - - - 2>e3; echo "cs7odd=$?" >> rc
/usr/bin/python3 ti.py $t > st3
pty set-ldisc 0 $t - 8 even - - - 2>e4; echo "cs8even=$?" >> rc
/usr/bin/python3 ti.py $t > st4
pty set-ldisc 0 $t 115200 8 none 1 - 257 2>e5; echo "restore=$?" >> rc
/usr/bin/python3 ti.py $t > st5

files.ti.py:
import fcntl, os, struct, sys, termios
fd = os.open(sys.argv[1], os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOCTTY)
a = termios.tcgetattr(fd)
sp = {getattr(termios, n): n for n in dir(termios) if n.startswith('B') and n[1:].isdigit()}
cs = {termios.CS5: 5, termios.CS6: 6, termios.CS7: 7, termios.CS8: 8}[a[2] & termios.CSIZE]
par = 'none' if not a[2] & termios.PARENB else ('odd' if a[2] & termios.PARODD else 'even')
buf = fcntl.ioctl(fd, 0x5424, b'\0\0\0\0')
print('ispeed=%s ospeed=%s cs=%d parity=%s cstopb=%d ignbrk=%d icrnl=%d ldisc=%d' % (sp.get(a[4]), sp.get(a[5]), cs, par, bool(a[2] & termios.CSTOPB), bool(a[0] & termios.IGNBRK), bool(a[0] & termios.ICRNL), struct.unpack('i', buf)[0]))

expected_files.st1: ispeed=B9600 ospeed=B9600 cs=7 parity=even cstopb=1 ignbrk=1 icrnl=0 ldisc=0
expected_files.st2: ispeed=B115200 ospeed=B115200 cs=8 parity=odd cstopb=0 ignbrk=1 icrnl=0 ldisc=0
expected_files.st3: ispeed=B115200 ospeed=B115200 cs=7 parity=odd cstopb=0 ignbrk=1 icrnl=0 ldisc=0
expected_files.st4: ispeed=B115200 ospeed=B115200 cs=8 parity=even cstopb=0 ignbrk=1 icrnl=0 ldisc=0
expected_files.st5: ispeed=B115200 ospeed=B115200 cs=8 parity=none cstopb=0 ignbrk=0 icrnl=0 ldisc=0

cases.oracle: Linux termios.h constants (B9600/B115200, CS5-CS8, PARENB/PARODD, CSTOPB, IGNBRK, ICRNL) read back with Python's termios module; a root fixture on the rental is required for CAP_SYS_ADMIN and the device node. The pty builtin has no reference executable.
cases.comparison: Per-step termios read back after each pty set-ldisc invocation: speed, character size, parity, stop bits and the iflag masks.
